current_answer: As of September 11, 2026, Grand Theft Auto VI remains committed to November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Official PlayStation Store pages now show regional PS5 unlock timestamps, while preorders, preload logistics, the extended look, and a coordinated hardware campaign support an active launch plan. Two prior official date movements still limit confidence, and these signals do not make the date a guarantee. No official PC platform or release date is published in the sources checked.

catalogue_card.question: Is GTA 6 still on for November 19?
catalogue_card.text: Yes on the current record: the November 19, 2026 console commitment remains live. PlayStation Store pages now show regional PS5 unlock times, but that operational detail is not a guarantee—and PC still has no official date.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Official PlayStation Store pages now expose regional digital-PS5 unlock timestamps, including 05:00 UTC in the United States and 11:00 UTC on November 18 in New Zealand; Xbox timing remains separate.
Preorders, November 12 preload logistics, the August extended look, and a PlayStation hardware tie-in support an active launch campaign but do not guarantee delivery.
Two earlier official date movements still limit confidence; no new official delay was found.
No official PC platform or release date is published in the checked launch materials.
uncertainty: An official commitment is not a guarantee.
PlayStation Store timestamps are operational metadata for digital PS5 listings and may change; they do not establish Xbox timing.
The PC sooner-than-expected report and editorial forecasts are unofficial; no official PC window exists.
The employment tribunal and leak coverage provide context but no inspected source links them to a current schedule movement.
No first-party pool analytics, repeat-use signal, or revenue signal exists yet.
